description_expanded:
Gated Seashore Village in Seagrove

50 steps to Seashore Circle private beach access

Complimentary (seasonal) beach chairs & umbrella!

Community pool!

Large balconies, spectacular views

5-minute stroll to stunning coastal dune lake

3 bikes!

Gas grill

4-star restaurants

Boutiques

Seashell Castle by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 NOTICE: From March 1st through October 31st, you and your sun-chasing squad get to lounge like royalty on complimentary beach chairs and an umbrella. Seashell Castle brings the charm in all the right ways. With breezy wraparound balconies and wide-open Gulf views, this three-story stunner sits inside the gated Seashore Village in Seagrove Beach. Think quiet, private, and just the right amount of fancy. Need a break from the beach? Take a dip in the sparkling community pool, shared with just two other homes (Coral Reef and Dolphin Run). Depending on the day, it might feel like your own private retreat. Inside, it’s all sunshine and good vibes.

The open living space is bright, bold, and roomy enough for everything from game night to dance breaks. Morning coffee with morning views? Get used to it. And evening wine? Sure! Welcome to Seashell Castle. It's not your average beach house, but then again, you're not here for an average vacation. Oversee 30A is your local vacation sidekick: Always nearby, never in the way. Our team is here daily (and nightly, too) to keep things smooth, simple, and stress-free. For larger groups you can book the two houses next door: Coral Reef (VRBO# 1882175) Dolphin Run (VRBO# 1883886) Overview: - On the beach (Seashore Circle private access) - 4 bedrooms, 3 baths - 2,100 sq ft - Complimentary beach chairs and an umbrella (March 1st - October 31st) - Wi-Fi - Community pool - Gas grill - 3 bikes included Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Guest Room: King bed, hall bathroom, TV - Living Room: Sleeper sofa, hall bathroom, TV SECOND FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, attached balcony, TV - Guest Room: 2 fulls, private bath, attached balcony, TV THIRD FLOOR - Guest Room: Twin daybed with trundle, attached balcony Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST.
